notes: Corrected: the and at t018 is added and the purpose lamed of לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת is unrepresented. Rule 14 marks a coordinator no conjunction morpheme answers to as added and forbids folding it into the preposition standing next to it, and rule 52's list of what a recast infinitive spends on its preposition is prepositions and complementizers, not coordinators.
The second purpose lamed, before לֶאֱכֹל, does take its written complementizer that under rule 52, and is unaffected.
